backend/main.mo: Motoko actor for a home services backend that manages bookings and reviews, providing CRUD operations including add, get, update, delete, and filter functions for both entities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three requirements for the ServiceCarousel component: removing navigation controls, converting carousel to a static stacked list, and preserving card visual appearance.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component or page's purpose and key implementation details for the TrustFix app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the TrustFix React SPA with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div mounting point for the Vite/React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, booking, contact, and reviews pages, wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: Modal booking form popup that collects customer details, validates inputs, and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message to TrustFix on submission; conditionally shows property type and square footage fields based on service type.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: Animated service card component for cleaning services that displays an image, price badge, features, and Book Now/WhatsApp action buttons, with intersection-observer-based fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Auto-advancing carousel component that fetches and displays featured customer reviews from the backend, with navigation controls and star ratings.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed floating button on the bottom-left that opens a WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button on the bottom-right with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying brand info, address, contact links, social icons, service category links, and quick navigation links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner section with a background image, headline, and two CTA buttons that open WhatsApp with pre-filled booking or call messages.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around page content, and scrolls to top on route change.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, a service search dropdown, and a WhatsApp call button.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: Animated card component for painting services displaying an image, price badge, star rating, features, and buttons to book via WhatsApp or request a free inspection.
A card component for displaying pest control services with an image, price badge, features list, and WhatsApp/Book Now action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, star rating, service label, date, and review text.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: An animated service card with intersection-observer visibility, showing service image, price, features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons.
Renders a carousel of service category cards with fallback image cycling, navigating to the services page with a category query param on click.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Displays a grid of service category cards with staggered scroll-based animations, fallback images, and navigation to the services page by category.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: A reusable star rating component supporting display and optional interactive rating selection.
An animated card for individual service subcategories with image, features, price, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons using intersection observer for entrance animation.
A form component that allows users to submit reviews with name, service type, star rating, and review text, using a mutation to call the backend actor and invalidating review queries on success.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines contact constants, WhatsApp link helper, TypeScript interfaces for services/categories/packages, and detailed service data including pest control subcategories with descriptions, prices, and features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
Custom hook that exposes a mutation for submitting a booking to the backend actor, then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message and invalidates booking queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports three React Query hooks—useGetFeaturedReviews, useGetAllReviews, and useGetAllBookings—that fetch data from the backend actor when it is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that filters and deduplicates service categories and individual services from the services data based on a search query string, returning up to 8 results.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Inter fonts, sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and declares custom animations and component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: A booking form page that collects user details (name, phone, service, property type, date, time) and sends the booking information to a WhatsApp number via a pre-filled message link.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact page displaying TrustFix's phone, WhatsApp, address, email, and working hours as styled cards with links.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The homepage composing the hero section, trust badges, service carousel, 'Why Choose Us' features grid, featured reviews carousel, and a WhatsApp CTA banner.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: A reviews page that fetches all reviews from the backend actor via React Query and displays them in a grid alongside a write-review form.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: A services listing page with expandable category sections, painting package cards with pricing/features, subcategory cards, and a booking form popup triggered by 'Book Now' buttons.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom brand colors, fonts (Inter, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and animations (fadeInUp, cardEnter, pulse-slow, wave) used across the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks the TrustFix project state (version 3), describing a task to convert the ServiceCarousel component from a slider/carousel UI into a plain vertically stacked list of service cards by removing navigation controls, swipe logic, and scroll-snap behavior while preserving card visuals.
